description: HiCOS PKI Native Smart Card is a dual interface (ISO 7816 & ISO 14443) cryptographic smart card and supports SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, Hash-DRBG, 3DES-3Key-MAC, 3DES-3Key encrypt/decrypt, RSA 2048 encrypt/decrypt (including RSA-CRT), RSA digital signature generation /verification(including RSA-CRT)
vendor: Chunghwa Telecom Co., Ltd. Telecommunication Laboratories
